CustomField.description: Master switch that disables the per-config Open Work Item Gate for this routing config. When TRUE, the engine skips the open-work-item check entirely and an agent can receive unlimited records of this object type — Max_Capacity__c is IGNORED. When FALSE (default), the engine enforces Max_Capacity__c (or 1 if Max_Capacity__c is null). Use TRUE only for high-volume, fire-and-forget routing where the agent should never be blocked by existing open records (e.g. broadcast notifications, bulk task fan-out). For normal pull-based queue routing, leave this FALSE and tune Max_Capacity__c instead.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to let an agent receive unlimited records of this type (skips capacity check). Leave unchecked to enforce Max_Capacity__c.
CustomField.label: Ignore Capacity
